messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

I’d like the refund to go back to my Amex card. I don’t have the order number handy—can you help me with this?

Yes—I can help, but first I need to authenticate your account so I can look up your orders and the tracking info.

Please reply with **one** of the following:
1) **Your email address**, or  
2) **Your first name + last name + ZIP code**

Also, for the return: you said **return everything except the pet bed** and send the refund to your **Amex card** (credit card).  
When you’ve authenticated, I’ll locate the order that was sent to **Texas**—if you can, tell me **the approximate order date** (or any part of the order total) to help me find the right one faster.
Sure! My name is Isabella Johansson and my ZIP code is 32286. I don’t remember the exact order date, but it was placed pretty recently. I hope that helps!
